parts.text: In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

Memorare Remember, O most gracious Virgin Mary, that never was it known that any one who fled to thy protection, implored thy help, and sought thy intercession, was left unaided. Inspired with this confidence, I fly unto thee, O Virgin of virgins, my Mother, to thee I come, before thee I stand sinful and sorrowful. O Mother of the Word Incarnate! despise not my petitions, but, in thy mercy, hear and answer me. Pause here to mention your request. Amen. O God, who has deigned to bless us with the favor of venerating the Blessed Virgin Mary under the title of Mother of the Forsaken, and has willed to bestow so much power on her intercession that no one should be abandoned who has recourse to her motherly help! Grant we beseech you to us, Your servants, the privilege that we all, who put ourselves under the protection of so exalted a Mother, may never be forsaken by your Divine Mercy, through Christ, Our Lord. Amen.
Our Lady of the Forsaken, pray for us!
In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

blocks.title: Days 1-9

fragments.text:
Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be thy name.
Thy kingdom come, thy will be done, on earth as it is in heaven.
Give us this day our daily bread, and forgive us our trespasses,
as we forgive those who trespass against us.
And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen.
fragments.title: Our Father

fragments.text:
Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee.
Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus.
Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
fragments.title: Hail Mary

fragments.text:
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit.
As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.
